full_details: Before you left the lodging you wrote a short line home. You are well. You send threescore shillings. You named Susanna, Hamnet, and Judith, and you commended yourself to your father and to Anne. You wrote nothing of butter or of prisons, and you did not answer the question she asked in April. At the nine o'clock rehearsal you gave the canvas and the line to John Heminges. His man was to take them to the Bell. The man did not speak, and you did not walk to Carter Lane. A bill in the house that morning was the second Caesar, a title and no sum, and it did not yet say their last. You played in the afternoon. At the day's end Raye brought the rest. It is their last. The Admiral's men are packing hampers, and no bill goes up tomorrow, and nobody over there will say why. Kemp said they have run. Heminges said they have been told, or else run, and that Bankside has nowhere to go of an afternoon but here. Margery said she would as soon they had somewhere. There was a rumour of padlocks if there is one more tumult. Nothing came back from home. At the lodging you wrote the fact apart from the reasons, and you left the reasons unchosen.
one_sentence: You sent the sixty shillings by another man's hand, played in the afternoon, and heard that the Rose's day was its last.
title: The Rose's last day
